description: Create a gajo.io short link for a URL and return it as shortUrl. Links follow your plan's code length and lifetime and count against its monthly quota. Pro plans can pass customCode for a branded gajo.io/c/{code} link, or shorten app deep links (myapp://...) with a web fallbackUrl.

customCode.description: Pro only: custom code (3-50 letters, digits, or hyphens). Can't be combined with lifetimeDays.

fallbackUrl.description: Pro, deep links only: web URL used when the app isn't installed.

lifetimeDays.description: Days until the link expires; capped at your plan maximum.

url.description: The long URL to shorten (http, https, mailto, tel, ftp, sftp; Pro: app deep links).

name: shorten_url

appLink.description: App links only: where iOS and Android go, and the page other devices see.

expiresDate.description: ISO-8601 instant; null when the link never expires.

title: Shorten a URL
